experiment: EXP5 — does repeat() fail atomically under a throwing callback?

detail: callback threw at value 1, yet 1 values had already been delivered
callback threw at value 2, yet 2 values had already been delivered
callback threw at value 99, yet 99 values had already been delivered

consequence: repeat() has no rollback. A caller that supplies a partially-rejecting callback receives a partial effect and an exception, with no way to tell from the return path which values landed. Nothing in the file declares this, so a description built from comments or types alone will not warn a caller.
